claim: Let \(k\) be any field of characteristic \(p>0\), let \(m\ge2\), and set \(A_m=k[t]/(t^m)\). The automorphism group scheme of \(A_m\) is smooth over \(k\) if and only if \(p\nmid m\). If \(m=q=p^e\) for \(e\ge1\), its full representing scheme is \(\operatorname{Spec} k[c_0,c_1,c_1^{-1},c_2,\ldots,c_{q-1}]/(c_0^q)\).

correctness.rationale: For arbitrary \(m\), the coefficient of \(t^{m-1}\) is \(m c_0 c_1^{m-1}\) plus terms divisible by \(c_0^2\); when \(p\nmid m\), this forces \(c_0=0\) on the full scheme. When \(p\mid m\), the derivation tangent space has dimension \(m\) versus scheme dimension \(m-1\). For \(m=p^e=q\), Frobenius gives \(u^q=c_0^q\), and the invertibility condition is exactly that \(c_1\) be a unit.
